items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Barney and Jimmy got mad with us because we left and in that band was Bill Coleman and J. C. and then we augmented with George James and Benny Morton, for the Pump Room

ctx.x: MCA. And William Morris was trying to

get the account, so they called on Teddy from William Morris Agency to go to the Pump Room in Chicago and we left the Cafe Society Uptown and Barney and Jimmy got mad with us because we left and in that band was Bill Coleman and J. C. and then we augmented with George James and Benny Morton, for the Pump Room, where we had to wear white tails.
